Spare Ribs & Sauerkraut
By: Anonymous
Published: Monday, November 30, 2009 - 11:52pm

Ingredients




Pork spare ribs, country style
Lemon juice
Kitchen bouquet
3 toes pressed garlic
1 jar Vlasic sauerkraut
Olive oil
1 cup water
2 beef bouillon cubes
1 onion, finely chopped
1 can new potatoes

Preparation

1 Rub spare ribs with lemon juice and kitchen bouquet. Brown spare ribs in olive oil. Drain grease. Add water, bouillon cubes, garlic and onion. Cover and simmer 45 to 50 minutes. Add sauerkraut and new potatoes. Simmer 15 to 20 minutes more.
